title: Document Processing Chains
summary: This module provides chains for processing documents, including a Map-Reduce chain for handling large texts and a FLARE chain for iterative, retrieval-augmented generation to refine responses based on uncertainty.

nodes.label: User Input
nodes.title: Initial User Input
nodes.description: The original text or query provided by the user for processing by the chains.

nodes.label: Final Output
nodes.title: Processed Result
nodes.description: The final generated or processed output from the document processing module.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: External Language Model
nodes.description: Provides text generation and understanding capabilities, essential for various chain operations.

nodes.label: MapReduceChain
nodes.title: Orchestrates Map-Reduce Document Processing
nodes.description: Splits large documents into chunks, processes them with an LLM (map), and then combines the results (reduce).

nodes.label: Text Splitter
nodes.title: Splits Documents into Chunks
nodes.description: Breaks down large input texts into smaller, manageable segments for parallel or sequential processing.

nodes.label: MapReduceDocumentsChain
nodes.title: Manages Map and Reduce Steps
nodes.description: An internal component that orchestrates the mapping of document chunks and their subsequent reduction.

nodes.label: LLMChain
nodes.title: Applies LLM to Document Chunks
nodes.description: Uses a Language Model to process individual document chunks or combine intermediate results during map and reduce phases.

nodes.label: ReduceDocumentsChain
nodes.title: Reduces Document Chunks
nodes.description: Combines processed document chunks into a single, coherent output, often after an initial mapping step.

nodes.label: FlareChain
nodes.title: Iterative RAG for Uncertain Responses
nodes.description: Implements FLARE (Active Retrieval Augmented Generation) to iteratively refine responses by identifying uncertainty, generating questions, and retrieving context.

nodes.label: Response Generator
nodes.title: Generates & Refines Responses
nodes.description: Produces initial responses and iteratively refines them using retrieved context and user input, often leveraging LLM log probabilities.

nodes.label: Question Generator
nodes.title: Generates Clarifying Questions
nodes.description: Creates targeted questions based on low-confidence spans in the current response to guide further information retrieval.

nodes.label: Retriever
nodes.title: Fetches Relevant Documents
nodes.description: Retrieves documents from a knowledge base or external source based on generated questions or user queries.

nodes.label: Finished Output Parser
nodes.title: Determines Response Completion
nodes.description: Analyzes the generated response to decide if the iterative process is complete or if further refinement/retrieval is needed.

groups.label: Document Transformation
groups.title: Map-Reduce Document Processing
groups.description: Components involved in splitting, mapping, and reducing large documents using language models.

groups.label: FLARE Iterative RAG
groups.title: Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation
groups.description: Components implementing the FLARE technique for refining responses through iterative question generation and retrieval.

groups.label: Information Retrieval
groups.title: Contextual Information Retrieval
groups.description: Component responsible for fetching relevant documents based on queries or generated questions.

groups.label: External Interfaces
groups.title: External Systems and Data
groups.description: Represents external inputs, outputs, and dependencies like Language Models.
